skills.name: list_files
skills.description: List files and directories with metadata. Defaults to the user's home directory when path is omitted.

skills.name: read_file
skills.description: Read text file contents at an explicit path with optional character offset.

skills.name: write_file
skills.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file at an explicit path. Set overwrite=true to replace an existing file.

skills.name: append_file
skills.description: Append text content to a file at an explicit path, creating it if it does not exist.

skills.name: edit_file
skills.description: Replace exactly one matching passage in a UTF-8 text file.

skills.name: make_directory
skills.description: Create a directory and any missing parent directories.

skills.name: move_path
skills.description: Move or rename a file or directory to a new destination path.

skills.name: copy_path
skills.description: Copy a file or directory to a new destination path.

skills.name: trash_path
skills.description: Move a file or directory to the desktop Trash for recovery.

skills.name: delete_path
skills.description: Permanently delete a file or directory. Set recursive=true to remove non-empty directories.

skills.name: inspect_file
skills.description: Inspect file or directory metadata including existence, type, size, modified date, permissions, and line count.

skills.name: search_files
skills.description: Find file or directory names recursively; defaults to the user's home directory.

skills.name: search_file_content
skills.description: Search text file contents under a directory or in one file; defaults to the user's home directory.
